_purpose: Pinned dangling-citation count for scripts/enforcement/close-artifact-gate.mjs --check. A `_inbox/` artifact cited by tracked canon that the committed tree does not contain is the defect this pins: a lane close produced in a seat worktree and never copied into main. Known debt is admitted here; new debt fails the control. Do not raise `dangling` to make CI green.
_howToChange: When debt is cleared, lower `dangling` and delete the cleared entries from `targets` IN THE SAME COMMIT that clears them. Lowering without deleting the target leaves the pin able to re-admit exactly the citation that was just fixed.
_scope: Citations from _dispatches/ and _catalog/dispatch_missions/ are exempt: a dispatch names the close its lane is to produce, which does not exist yet by construction. .github/enforcement-baseline.json is exempt: it records violation fixtures that were injected and removed. Exempted targets are listed under `exemptForwardLookingTargets` in --json output.
snapshot: doc_repo eb28f349 - 24 -> 21, by closing two of the three classifier gaps this pin had NAMED rather than by relaxing anything.
